001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * History log record Bolus Requested 1/3, opCode 64, size 26.
009 *
010 * <br>
011 *
012 * 
013 * <table border='1'>
014 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
015 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>64</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
016 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Bolus Requested 1/3"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_BOLUS_REQUESTED_MSG1"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByAndroid</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
020 * </table>
021 */
022@HistoryLogProps(
023    opCode = 64,
024    displayName = "Bolus Requested 1/3",
025    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_REQUESTED_MSG1",
026    usedByAndroid = true,
027    usedByTidepool = true
028)
029public class BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
030    
031    private int bolusId;
032    private int bolusTypeId;
033    private boolean correctionBolusIncluded;
034    private int carbAmount;
035    private int bg;
036    private float iob;
037    private long carbRatio;
038    
039    public BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog() {}
040    
041    public BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusTypeId, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio) {
042        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, bolusTypeId, correctionBolusIncluded, carbAmount, bg, iob, carbRatio, 0);
043    }
044
045    public BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusTypeId, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio, int headerHighNibble) {
046        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
047        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, bolusTypeId, correctionBolusIncluded, carbAmount, bg, iob, carbRatio, headerHighNibble);
048        this.bolusId = bolusId;
049        this.bolusTypeId = bolusTypeId;
050        this.correctionBolusIncluded = correctionBolusIncluded;
051        this.carbAmount = carbAmount;
052        this.bg = bg;
053        this.iob = iob;
054        this.carbRatio = carbRatio;
055        
056    }
057
058    public int typeId() {
059        return 64;
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * <table border="1">
064     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog:</caption>
065     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>bolusTypeId</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>correctionBolusIncluded</code></td><td><code>raw[13] != 0</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>carbAmount</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>bg</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>iob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>carbRatio</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
072     * </table>
073     */
074    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
075        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
076        this.cargo = raw;
077        parseBase(raw);
078        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
079        this.bolusTypeId = raw[12];
080        this.correctionBolusIncluded = raw[13] != 0;
081        this.carbAmount = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
082        this.bg = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
083        this.iob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
084        this.carbRatio = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
085        
086    }
087
088    
089    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusType, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio) {
090        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, bolusType, correctionBolusIncluded, carbAmount, bg, iob, carbRatio, 0);
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * <table border="1">
095     * <caption>Byte layout for BolusRequestedMsg1HistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
096     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
097     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
098     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
100     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
101     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
102     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
105     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
106     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
107     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>(byte) bolusType</code></td></tr>
108     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>(byte) (correctionBolusIncluded ? 1 : 0)</code></td></tr>
109     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(carbAmount) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
110     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(carbAmount) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
111     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bg) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
112     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bg) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
113     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
114     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
115     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
116     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toFloat(iob) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
117     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
118     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
119     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
120     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>toUint32(carbRatio) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
121     * </table>
122     */
123    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int bolusType, boolean correctionBolusIncluded, int carbAmount, int bg, float iob, long carbRatio, int headerHighNibble) {
124        return Bytes.combine(
125            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(64, headerHighNibble),
126            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
127            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
128            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId), 
129            new byte[]{ (byte) bolusType }, 
130            new byte[]{ (byte) (correctionBolusIncluded ? 1 : 0) }, 
131            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(carbAmount), 
132            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bg), 
133            Bytes.toFloat(iob), 
134            Bytes.toUint32(carbRatio));
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * @return the ID of the bolus operation
139     */
140    public int getBolusId() {
141        return bolusId;
142    }
143
144    public int getBolusTypeId() {
145        return bolusTypeId;
146    }
147
148    /**
149     * @return how the bolus was requested, or null if the raw value is not recognized.
150     *
151     * <p>Treated as a scalar enum rather than the bitmask used by
152     * {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog#getBolusTypes()}. <b>Validated against a 48k-record real-pump
153     * capture:</b> cross-correlating this field with the bolus's delivery source (as reported by
154     * {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog.BolusSource}) by bolus ID showed 0 ({@code INSULIN}) agreeing
155     * with {@code QUICK_BOLUS} on 25/25 boluses and 3 ({@code REMOTE}) agreeing with
156     * {@code BLUETOOTH_REMOTE_BOLUS} on 118/118 boluses. Raw values 1 ({@code CARB}) and 2
157     * ({@code AUTOMATIC_CORRECTION}) were not observed in the capture and remain unverified.
158     */
159    public BolusType getBolusType() {
160        return BolusType.fromId(bolusTypeId);
161    }
162
163    /**
164     * The way in which a bolus was requested, as reported by this log only.
165     *
166     * <p>Value names ported from tconnectsync and not independently verified here; see
167     * {@link #getBolusType()}.
168     *
169     * <p>Deliberately distinct from {@link BolusDeliveryHistoryLog.BolusType}, which is a bitmask
170     * of the components making up a bolus and is a different field with a different encoding.
171     */
172    public enum BolusType {
173        INSULIN(0),
174        CARB(1),
175        AUTOMATIC_CORRECTION(2),
176        REMOTE(3),
177        ;
178
179        private final int id;
180        BolusType(int id) {
181            this.id = id;
182        }
183
184        public int id() {
185            return id;
186        }
187
188        public static BolusType fromId(int id) {
189            for (BolusType b : values()) {
190                if (b.id() == id) {
191                    return b;
192                }
193            }
194            return null;
195        }
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * @return if the correction bolus is included
200     */
201    public boolean getCorrectionBolusIncluded() {
202        return correctionBolusIncluded;
203    }
204
205    /**
206     * @return carbs in grams.
207     *
208     * <p>The ordering of this field (offset 14) and {@link #getBg()} (offset 16) was validated
209     * against a 48k-record real-pump capture: offset 14 held carb-gram values, while offset 16
210     * held plausible BG values in mg/dL across 143/143 correlated records.
211     */
212    public int getCarbAmount() {
213        return carbAmount;
214    }
215
216    /**
217     * @return BG in mg/dL (offset 16). See the note on {@link #getCarbAmount()}; this ordering was
218     * validated against a 48k-record real-pump capture.
219     */
220    public int getBg() {
221        return bg;
222    }
223
224    /**
225     * @return current insulin on board.
226     *
227     * <p>The analysis attached to the linked issue reports this field reading zero on records
228     * whose corresponding {@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog} and {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog}
229     * carry a nonzero IOB, and recommends preferring those logs as the source of IOB. Not
230     * reproduced here; the records committed to this repository carry a nonzero value.
231     */
232    public float getIob() {
233        return iob;
234    }
235
236    /**
237     * @return carb ratio from the insulin delivery profile, in thousandths of a gram per unit
238     */
239    public long getCarbRatio() {
240        return carbRatio;
241    }
242
243    /**
244     * @return carb ratio from the insulin delivery profile, in grams per unit
245     */
246    public double getCarbRatioGramsPerUnit() {
247        return carbRatio / 1000.0;
248    }
249}
